pattern.description: APA102 vision LED indices 1 and 2 on together, white 0.30 each.
pattern.gcode:
VISION_LIGHT_OFF
SET_LED LED=vision_light INDEX=1 RED=0.300 GREEN=0.300 BLUE=0.300
SET_LED LED=vision_light INDEX=2 RED=0.300 GREEN=0.300 BLUE=0.300
pattern.name: white_led_1_2_level_0p30

recommendation.best_measured_y_feature_light: white_led_2 at 0.45 remains the primary default
recommendation.gcode:
VISION_LIGHT_OFF
SET_LED LED=vision_light INDEX=2 RED=0.450 GREEN=0.450 BLUE=0.450
recommendation.reason: The 1+2 mix is usable, but it does not clearly beat LED 2 alone. Tight-line residual is effectively tied, tight-line correlation is essentially the same, and LED 2 alone keeps the cleaner wider-context residual.
recommendation.validated_fallback_gcode:
VISION_LIGHT_OFF
SET_LED LED=vision_light INDEX=1 RED=0.300 GREEN=0.300 BLUE=0.300
SET_LED LED=vision_light INDEX=2 RED=0.300 GREEN=0.300 BLUE=0.300
